---
title: AI Live Assistant
---

Use **Start** and **Stop** to control a live audio/camera conversation. The
spatial card shows connection state and conversation text. Grant the media
permissions and supply Gemini credentials before testing a conversation.

The optional API-key prompt is for a local prototype. Use
[provider setup](/integrations/ai-providers) for production authentication.
Test Stop, remote disconnection, and a failed connection as well as a normal turn.
